context: Two news editors prep an evening political segment
purpose: Teach: 社会党/歳出/不定期/追跡/延期/負傷/言動/無責任

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今夜の政治コーナーですが、社会党の歳出削減案を冒頭に持ってきます。
lines.en: For tonight's politics segment, we'll lead with the Social Democratic Party's spending-cut proposal.
lines.style: Professional newsroom tone, crisp and decision-oriented opening from junior editor.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 了解。ただ、党内の不定期な会合での発言らしいから、裏取りはちゃんと追跡してね。
lines.en: Got it. But it sounds like a remark from an irregular internal meeting, so make sure you trace the sourcing properly.
lines.style: Calm senior editor giving cautious, experienced guidance with mild warning.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 実は記者会見が一度延期になってまして、原稿の最終版がまだ届いてないんです。
lines.en: Actually the press conference got postponed once, so the final version of the script hasn't arrived yet.
lines.style: Slightly apologetic, reporting a logistical hiccup in measured workplace register.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 厄介ね。あと、昨日の街頭演説で支持者が負傷した件、扱いどうする?
lines.en: That's annoying. Also, about yesterday's street speech where a supporter got injured—how are we handling it?
lines.style: Pragmatic, problem-solving voice with a slight sigh of professional fatigue.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 短く触れるだけにします。議員本人の言動には直接関係ないので。
lines.en: I'll just touch on it briefly. It isn't directly tied to the lawmaker's own words or conduct.
lines.style: Measured editorial judgment, balancing fairness and time constraints.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 賢明ね。視聴者に無責任な印象を与える編集だけは絶対に避けて。
lines.en: Wise call. Just absolutely avoid any edit that comes across as irresponsible to the viewers.
lines.style: Firm mentoring tone, emphasizing journalistic ethics with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 肝に銘じます。じゃあ社会党の歳出パートを軸に、九時までに通します。
lines.en: I'll take that to heart. So I'll center it on the SDP spending segment and push it through by nine.
lines.style: Earnest commitment, finalizing the workflow with respectful resolve.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お願い。原稿上がったら、私が最終チェックするから直接持ってきて。
lines.en: Please do. Once the script's ready, bring it straight to me—I'll do the final check.
lines.style: Warm but authoritative closing instruction from supervising editor.
